correctness.rationale: Exhaustive \(24^4\) row-permutation generation captures every labeled \(4\times4\) Latin square. Trade legality and entire adjacency list are independently reconstructed by backtracking and symbol transpositions, with identical SHA-256 digest. Exactly computed \(BB^{\mathsf T}\) entries are diagonal 12 and off-diagonal 0 or 2, allowing integral symmetric H. The included standard-library verifier checks \(p(H)=0\) on all 144 basis vectors (not by numerical eigensolver), and the five power traces fix all eigenspace dimensions by Vandermonde uniqueness. Bipartite singular-value transfer yields the exact 576-dimensional characteristic polynomial. Normalized adjacency is \(A/\sqrt{48}\), giving the lazy-walk gap; independent all-pairs BFS verifies diameter 6.

Direct mathematical-record and literature queries found no full spectral equivalent. Davis 2026 already records the identical labeled graph, its 144:432 bipartition and Laplacian top-mode; these are openly credited, not newly claimed. value.rationale: The first nontrivial order with two Latin-square isotopy types yields a natural 576-state local-trade graph, important for understanding generation and sampling by small interchanges. Its exact full spectrum, nullity 318 and degree-adjusted random-walk relaxation constant give meaningful global structure that the two-vertex quotient and 144:432 degree partition cannot provide. The complete answer concerns a motivated natural finite object with no arbitrary slicing; no general-order theorem is claimed.
